addPageFeatureDescription: Kuvumela ukudala amakhasi amasha kusuka kubha ephezulu, izenzo zohlaka, nezenzo zosesho lwemiyalo.
deletePageFeatureDescription: Kuvumela ukususa amakhasi kusuka ezenzweni zekhasi, ezenzweni zohlaka, nezinqubo zokuphatha ezihlobene.
outlineDesignerFeatureDescription: Kuvula amathuluzi esakhiwo sesayithi, kufaka phakathi izenzo zohlaka nokusebenza kokuphatha Isakhiwo.
styleGuideFeatureDescription: Kubonisa ukufinyelela Kumhlahlandlela Wesitayela kumathuluzi okuphatha nasezinqamuleni zosesho lwemiyalo.
insightsFeatureDescription: Kuvula Imibiko ekuphatheni nasekusesheni kwemiyalo ukuze ukubuka kokuhlaziya nemininingwane kutholakale.
siteManifestFeatureDescription: Kulawula izigaba Zezilungiselelo Zesayithi zeMininingwane, Amabhulokhi, nokulungiselelwa Kwesihleli.
themeManifestFeatureDescription: Kuvula isigaba sezilungiselelo Zokubukeka/Zethimu ekuphathweni kwesayithi.
authorManifestFeatureDescription: Kuvula iphrofayela yombhali nezilungiselelo zemethadatha yombhali ekuphathweni kwesayithi.
seoManifestFeatureDescription: Kuvula izilungiselelo zenjini yosesho nokwenziwa ngcono kwemethadatha ekuphathweni kwesayithi.
pageBreakFeatureDescription: Kubonisa izilawuli zokuhlela imethadatha yezinga lekhasi njengesihloko, isithonjana, isimo, omaka, nokukhiya.
addBlockFeatureDescription: Kubonisa isiphequluli samabhulokhi futhi kuvumela ukungeza amabhulokhi amasha okuqukethwe ngenkathi uhlela.
popularGizmosFeatureDescription: Kubonisa isigaba samabhulokhi Athandwayo ngaphakathi kwesikhethi samabhulokhi.
recentGizmosFeatureDescription: Kubonisa isigaba samabhulokhi Akamuva ngaphakathi kwesikhethi samabhulokhi.
contentMapFeatureDescription: Kubonisa iphaneli yemephu/yesakhiwo sokuqukethwe kwekhasi ngenkathi uhlela okuqukethwe.
viewSourceFeatureDescription: Kuvula ukubuka komthombo we-HTML ukuze uhlele ngqo i-markup yekhasi.
uploadMediaFeatureDescription: Kuvula izinqubo zokulayisha amafayela nokufinyelela okuhlobene kokuphatha imidiya/amafayela.
onlineMediaFeatureDescription: Kuvula ukuhlanganiswa kwemidiya ku-inthanethi nemithombo yokusesha imidiya ekude.
communityFeatureDescription: Kuvula umongo wosesho lwemiyalo ohlobene nomphakathi nezenzo ezigxile ekufinyeleleni.
